# Local frontend dependencies

- GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0, distributed from the official npm package via https://unpkg.com/gsap@3.15.0/dist/ . The original license banner is retained. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ . Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/ .
- MapLibre GL JS 5.6.2, UMD build and stylesheet from https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/dist/ . The original license is included as `maplibre-LICENSE.txt`. Documentation: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/ .

Maps retain the source attribution in the visible map. Base tiles: OpenStreetMap / CARTO. Terrain: Mapterhorn. All location coordinates are approximate geographic context for the research, not trail navigation.
